parent_objective: design mixed per-case radius profile after medium old-key boundary and conservative utility shortfall

forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower exact or replay thresholds
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not make replay labels actor inputs
hypothesis: A mixed per-case radius profile can preserve the M420 conservative proof pass while recovering more of the M420 medium utility movement by tightening only the active old-key 10023 boundary and loosening non-boundary rows.
success_criteria: identify the exact M420 medium proof-failing row and branch
define a mixed radius profile with 10023 tightened and non-boundary rows allowed more slack
pre-register the next export/probe sequence without PPO
keep primary M420 proof and utility thresholds unchanged
failure_criteria: design ignores the M420 medium old-key failure
design requires PPO or actor input changes

commands.name: mixed_radius_boundary_design
commands.command: Design a per-case mixed-radius profile after M420: medium failed only old-key 10023, conservative passed proof but retained only 11.5 percent recovery utility.

decision_rule: M421 should admit a mixed-radius anchor export/probe only if it preserves all M420 proof thresholds and keeps the primary recovery-retention target at 0.20.

mixed_profiles.mixed_a: medium radii except conservative radius for 10023
mixed_profiles.mixed_c: mixed_b plus loose radius for M267 rows 6 and 15
